title: viola canina subsp. lancifolia
intro: Viola canina subsp. lancifolia, commonly known as Wood Pansy, is a flowering plant in the violet family. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and its ability to aid in digestion and reduce stress. The therapeutic actions of Viola canina subsp. lancifolia include its sedative and antispasmodic effects, which can help to calm the nervous system and relieve muscle cramps. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, iridoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
